detail.longDescription: 📰 Sonic the Hedgehog 2 AGA - An AI Sonic 2 port for Amiga AGA via EAB moderator Cody Jarrett EAB moderator Cody Jarrett has ported over Sega's Sonic the Hedgehog 2 over to the Commodore Amiga AGA, delivering the entire game from the iconic logo to the final credits.
